Glossary
Billabong - "ox bow lake" - a pond left behind after river changes course
Billy - water for making coffee or tea, boiled over camp file
Jumbuck - sheep
Squatter - land owner
Swag - bag of belongings carried over one's back
Swagman - a man who carries a swag
Waltzing Matilda - traveling with one's belongings carried over one's back
